captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a circular adapter ring, commonly used as a lamp shade reducer or collar. It features a wide, flat outer flange at the base and a raised cylindrical collar in the center. The interior of the ring is stepped, starting with a larger internal diameter at the top of the collar and dropping down to a smaller through-hole at the bottom flange level.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric lamp shade adapter ring in OpenSCAD. The design should allow the user to adjust the outer flange diameter and height, the inner collar diameter and height, the main inner through-hole diameter, and the secondary stepped internal diameter.
captions.factory: The model is constructed using a difference() boolean operation. The additive portion is a union() of two cylinder() primitives: a wide, thin base cylinder representing the flange, and a taller, narrower cylinder representing the collar. The subtractive portion consists of two cylinder() primitives: one representing the central through-hole spanning the full height, and a second, larger-diameter cylinder translated upwards along the Z-axis to create the internal counterbore step.
